goal: Discover consumers and declared check candidates before a coordinated change, resume after drift, and deliver independently checked outcomes.
subset: Indexed declaration/reference relationships; built-in test candidates; explicit exact-file check associations. No runtime dispatch or behavioral coverage proof.
cases: reviewed multi-file delivery and independent patch replay
oracle: Independent fixture AST coordinates, expected consumer edges, and executable public behavior; retained deterministic results with no live-agent claim.
direct_edit_boundary: New-file scaffolding, enum/struct/attribute wiring, declaration reordering, Lean definitions and prose use direct edits. Existing Rust/Python function bodies and free-function insertion use reviewed native author batches on the actual repository; retained dogfood artifacts identify the operations.
